description:
Validate a standalone tsconfig with an exact TypeScript compiler version (5.4.5, 5.5.4, 5.6.3, 5.7.3, 5.8.3, 5.9.3 or 7.0.2) and return the compiler's own diagnostics with references.
When to use: Use when a tsconfig option is rejected or you need to know whether an option exists in a given TypeScript version. 'extends' and project files are not resolved.
Notes: No account or token needed.
Example arguments: {"typescript":"5.9.3","config":{"compilerOptions":{"target":"ES2022","module":"NodeNext","strict":true}}}

config.description: tsconfig content as a JSON object or JSONC text.

typescript.description: Exact TypeScript version from the list above.

name: validate_tsconfig
title: Validate a tsconfig.json
